title: Aoyagi Toya — Popping Puyos At Lightspeed〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like we've been on a nice roll lately.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep this up and get into really good shape going into our next show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. So, let's meet at the same time tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. Shiraishi, Azusawa, there's something I need to give you before you leave.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, these are VIP passes to the Gaming Expo...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You guys said how that gaming tournament was offering these as the prize for winning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does that mean you guys won?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sadly, no...
The manager gave us these as a token of his appreciation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, really?! That's so generous of him!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. He's a very nice person.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
I'm sure I'll get another chance in the future if I stay in this line of work. More importantly, you helped make this day absolutely unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: To see my grandfather's store filled with customers, and to see them all smiling... I never thought such a day would ever come.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank for that, so please, take these as a small token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you're so good at video games, Aoyagi. You guys not being able to win must mean that it was a tough tournament.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we had some very heated battles and I had a lot of fun playing against Kusanagi and Otori, who won in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Kusanagi and Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Kusanagi in particular was very good...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good? She was way better than that. She was better than your average Joe even for games that she didn't seem all that familiar with.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had no idea that she was so good at video games!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, what games did you guys play during this tournament?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we played a first-person survival game, a puzzle game and even made Print Stickers.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Print Stickers?!
As in the stickers you make by taking pictures of yourself and doodling all over them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We had to do that for the first round and it made me want to leave afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this was our entry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude...! Why do you have that...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought we could talk a little about the tournament while handing over the tickets.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thought we agreed to never bring it up again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I was under the impression that Azusawa and Shiraishi were exempted from that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess there's no use crying over spilt milk...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
Y-You guys even posed!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't do this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll be taking that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we weren't done looking!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You two looked so close and like you were really enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Enjoying ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Hehehe...
I know this wasn't easy for you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, quit giggling.
You think I'm happy about this at all?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't say that... H-Hehe. Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... I'm never doing this again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold on...
You're not thinking about doing this again, are you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was since it was just the two of us this time around. I thought it'd be good for the four of us to experience it together as a way to get on the same wavelength...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I kind of want to try doing that as well. And like what Aoyagi said, we'd get to share the experience...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, shouldn't you throw your partner a bone if they show interest in doing something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, if I ever feel like it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great! I really appreciate it, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, for now, why don't we head over to my place so you guys can show my dad that picture?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! There's no way I'm letting that happen!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, never ever hand that picture to her again! Got it?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood.
If you're that against it, I'll refrain from doing so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good. Never means never, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aww, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't think that I'm gonna forget about this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
